sourceNote: NAF rev2 (INSEE). Odysseus's own targeting inference, not a published EAA/NAF correspondence table, except where flagged 'definitional' because INSEE's own class definition names electronic distance selling explicitly, or (2026-08-22) because docs/obligation-basis.md's 'Hotels and accommodation' entry upgraded that reading to 'secondary' for accommodation booking specifically. NEVER cite this list, or 'sector', to a prospect as evidence of anything (docs/prospect-qualification.md section 4). It is a recall filter narrowing which Sirene stock rows get fetched, not the qualification predicate itself - a non-matching NAF code excludes a candidate, but a matching one alone never qualifies one (docs/prospect-qualification.md section 3, six conditions).

codes.label: Vente à distance sur catalogue général
codes.rationale: INSEE's own NAF rev2 definition for class 47.91 explicitly includes sales via 'sites internet, applications mobiles, catalogues imprimés ou téléphone'. Not 100% synonymous with 'has a working online checkout' (catalogue/telemarketing sales also fall under it) - the fetch/scan stage's transactional-flow detector, not this code, actually confirms a checkout.

codes.label: Vente à distance sur catalogue spécialisé
codes.rationale: Same INSEE class 47.91 definitional text as 47.91A, specialised-catalogue variant.

codes.label: Autres commerces de détail en magasin non spécialisé
codes.rationale: Illustrative only. Large-format non-specialised retail commonly runs e-commerce alongside physical stores, but NAF alone can't confirm a checkout exists. Not enabled for the first wave; operator to review and expand this list before enabling.

codes.label: Commerce de détail d'ordinateurs, d'unités périphériques et de logiciels en magasin spécialisé
codes.rationale: Illustrative only. Electronics retail is high-plausibility omnichannel. Not enabled for the first wave.

codes.label: Commerce de détail d'habillement en magasin spécialisé
codes.rationale: Illustrative only. Clothing retail is high-plausibility omnichannel. Not enabled for the first wave.

codes.label: Commerce de détail de jeux et jouets en magasin spécialisé
codes.rationale: Illustrative only. Toy retail is high-plausibility omnichannel. Not enabled for the first wave.

codes.label: Hôtels et hébergement similaire
codes.rationale: 2026-08-22 wave: docs/obligation-basis.md's 'Hotels and accommodation' entry (upgraded disputed -> secondary) states a booking flow concluding a consumer contract online is generally treated as electronic commerce, several independent sources apply this to tourism/hotels specifically, and hotels are now treated as on comparable legal footing to a standard online shop for outreach purposes. Held back from the first wave for volume/framing-sequencing reasons only, not legal weakness, per docs/prospect-qualification.md section 4's own note - now enabled. The fetch/scan stage's transactional-flow detector, not this code, confirms an actual booking engine exists.

codes.label: Hébergement touristique et autre hébergement de courte durée
codes.rationale: Same INSEE hébergement class family and same obligation-basis.md reading as 55.10Z, covering chambres d'hôtes and short-stay tourist accommodation - explicitly part of Odysseus's named hospitality segment alongside hotels (docs/research/sector-reference-stats/hospitality.md).

codes.label: Restauration traditionnelle
codes.rationale: Not enabled. docs/obligation-basis.md's hotel upgrade is specific to accommodation booking (a contract concluded online); a restaurant table reservation is not generally the same kind of transaction and has not received the same legal-reading review. Enable only after that reading is checked the way hotels were, not by analogy to 55.10Z/55.20Z.
